author: reek
body: Caller identity for the per-caller daily deal: the X-Forwarded-For header when a proxy supplies it, else the who query parameter, else the shared name the-proxy. The service day is the PIT tick counter divided into day-sized slices -- boot-relative, which is honest: the house's day starts when the house opens.

author: reek
body: One connection per iteration: fresh listening transport, accept, read the request, route, respond, close. The gateway MAC is seeded into the ARP cache so the SYN-ACK reply never waits on resolution; the address is the fixed NAT gateway MAC codex-vm presents.
